card.name: Start of words like remove, remain, remnant
card.fires_on: The first letters of words beginning with "rem" (Rem-oval, rem-ains, rem-nant, rem-it, Rem-edies), before the rest of the word is written. It also fires weakly on other word starts such as Re or RE.

modes.label: Rem- word starts
modes.description: The opening piece of a word that begins with rem, such as removal, remains, remnant, remit or remedies.
modes.example: Removal of some of the lymph nodes in the armpit to aid in staging of breast cancer. A growth that is NOT cancerous. <<Rem>>oval of a sample of tissue that is

modes.label: Other Re/Ra starts in names
modes.description: The opening of a name or other word that starts with Re, RE or Rab, a weaker response.
modes.example: basic TSE research that has focused on in vivo early diagnosis and the prevention of possible (also iatrogenic) transmission. Holger F.<< Rab>>enau

card.writes: It lowers the chance of the word "remote" coming next, so it likely stops the model from finishing a "rem" start as "remote".
card.plain: It lights up on the first letters of words like removal or remains, when the model is still working out which word it is.
